ValidationRule.description: User should not change Account Plan Status from UI.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(OR( ISNEW(),ISCHANGED(Plan_Status__c)),OR( ISPICKVAL(Plan_Status__c,"Submitted for Approval"), ISPICKVAL(Plan_Status__c,"Approved"), ISPICKVAL(Plan_Status__c,"Rejected") ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Use approval process to Submit, Approve or Reject the Account Plan.
